vcc_submit.note: Final-phase scores stay hidden until the winners are announced, so no score is recorded here.

provenance_note: Assembled by hand from logs/build-submission.log, logs/prep.log and logs/submit.log,
not written by scripts/20 as usual: the machine lost power during that run's `vcc prep`
step, after the .h5ad had been written and verified complete. `vcc prep` was then re-run
standalone on that same .h5ad, which is also the lower-memory path (no parent process
holding the control matrices). The shrinkage figures are as scripts/20 printed them, to
three decimal places; re-running `python scripts/20_make_vcc_submission.py --method mean`
reproduces them exactly, since the pipeline is seeded (seed 0).
prep_peak_gib in vcc/sizing.py predicted ~21.3 GiB for this file; it actually committed
about 31 GB, which that model does not capture for an internally gzip-compressed input.
